findings.title: Acceptance test does not exercise the production resolver
findings.message: The acceptance anchor is attached to a test-local substitute, so the production resolver can regress while the test remains green.
findings.quote_or_snippet: The test constructs a local substitute instead of invoking the production resolver.

failure_chain.source_or_trigger: The production combat catalog resolver changes behavior.
failure_chain.state_or_representation: ACC:T225.6 remains bound to a test-local substitute.
failure_chain.bad_result_or_consequence: The acceptance test stays green while production resolution is incorrect.

findings.existing_safeguard_gap: The deterministic anchor check proves the anchor exists but does not prove the test invokes production behavior.
findings.severity_rationale: The issue weakens one acceptance proof but does not directly demonstrate a production outage, so the original P1 is demoted to medium.
findings.suggested_change: Replace the test-local substitute with the production resolver and assert the expected result and failure path.
